Proves AR-6's `notIn` operator on a `string` field, with SEM-2's null-inclusion rule applying to the set-negative form exactly as it does to `neq`/`notContains`. AG Grid's `SetFilterModel` (`iSetFilter.ts`) carries only an inclusion list (`values: (string|null)[]`) — there is no wire-level invert/exclude flag, so no native `filterModel` shape can express `notIn`. This fixture uses the `customFilters` (OQ-11) extension point to inject the IR fragment directly — see the category README for the same rationale applied to 005/006/038. Per SEM-1's pinned collation-vs-pattern-match split, Postgres compiles to `status COLLATE craticula_ci <> ALL($1) OR status IS NULL`, never `ILIKE`, and Mongo carries a query-level `collation: {locale, strength: 2}` alongside the `$nin` pipeline stage.
